summary: Add coerceIntFlag()/coerceBoolFlag() so --num-results/--moderation/--stream on websearch and --num-results on find-similar map to the correct wire types (int/bool instead of string).
reason: The OpenAPI anyOf flattening emits integer/boolean fields as StringVar flags; Exa rejects string-typed numbers/booleans with HTTP 400 'expected number/boolean, received string'.
